description: This file defines the NoteEditFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for editing notes within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages UI components, auto-saving, keyboard interactions, and applies branding.

classes.name: NoteEditFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class for editing notes, handling UI interactions, auto-saving, and branding within the Nextcloud Notes app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets up the handler for main thread operations.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Configures the options menu visibility for editing and preview modes.

methods.name: getScrollView
methods.description: Returns the ScrollView component for scrolling operations.

methods.name: scrollToY
methods.description: Scrolls the view to a specific Y position.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout of the editable content.

methods.name: getSearchNextButton
methods.description: Returns the button for searching the next occurrence.

methods.name: getSearchPrevButton
methods.description: Returns the button for searching the previous occurrence.

methods.name: getDirectEditingButton
methods.description: Returns the button for direct editing.

methods.name: getNormalEditButton
methods.description: Returns null as this fragment does not have a normal edit button.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view hierarchy.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the text watcher and restores last selection state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current selection state.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Adds text watcher and opens keyboard if needed.

methods.name: onNoteLoaded
methods.description: Loads note content into the editor, applying preferences and restoring selection.

methods.name: openSoftKeyboard
methods.description: Requests focus and shows the soft keyboard.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes text watcher, cancels timers, and detects keyboard visibility.

methods.name: cancelTimers
methods.description: Removes auto-save callbacks.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the current text content of the editor.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves the current note and resets the unsaved edit flag.

methods.name: autoSave
methods.description: Performs auto-saving with delay and callback handling.

methods.name: colorWithText
methods.description: Highlights search text in the editor.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles and sets account info.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new fragment instance with note and account IDs.

methods.name: newInstanceWithNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new fragment instance with a new note object.
